build_ucf101_dataset: build a UCF101Dataset instance with video clips, frame rate, and audio samples for action recognition
create_ucf101_from_config: create a UCF101Dataset from a config dict with split, video_dir, and metadata_file parameters
load_ucf101_metadata: load precomputed UCF101 dataset metadata from a cached file path for faster initialization
save_ucf101_metadata: save UCF101 dataset metadata to a file path to avoid recomputing on future loads
register_ucf101_dataset: register the UCF101 dataset class with the classy_vision dataset registry using the ucf101 name
